confirm.title: Link your Slack account
confirm.body: Link the Slack account @{username} to your School of Gaming admin account? That Slack account will be able to approve substitutes on your behalf. Only link an account that is yours.
confirm.failed: Something went wrong and your account wasn’t linked. Try again.

linked.title: Linked to @{username}
linked.body: You can now approve substitutes from Slack.

used.title: This link has already been used
used.body: Each link works once. Run /link in Slack again to get a new one.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Links expire after 10 minutes. Run /link in Slack again to get a new one.

missingToken.title: This link is incomplete
missingToken.body: Run /link in Slack again to get a new one.

refused.title: Only admins can link a Slack account
refused.body: This account can’t link one. If you’re an admin, sign in with your admin account.
